subject: Using data from computer in application

messages.author: 0a6a97efcaf21ef3
messages.subject: Using data from computer in application
parts:
Hello,

I created an application that uses a dataset that I have stored as a txt file on my computer. I have it stored in the same folder as my ui.R and server.R files. I have set my working directory to the folders with these files, but when I deploy the application it does not work properly. According to the output displayed from the showLogs() command, the data is not found. Do I need to store the data somewhere else to deploy it with my application? Also, what is the size limit for this data?

Thanks!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Using data from computer in application
parts:
Hi Megan,
If the txt file is at the same level of your ui.R and server.R, and you are loading it in your R code by assuming that the file is at the root (example:  read.csv("myfile.txt")) it should work.  If you are using absolute paths, you will have issues. 

If this doesn't help, please attach the section of your code that loads the file, and a directory listing that includes the ui.R/server.R and the text file.

Best,
Tareef
